title: Veterans Pension Retroactive Releases — Counting the Months Owed
content:
In a retroactive Veterans Pension release under a rate adjustment, the months owed follow the payments already issued. The count starts from the adjustment's effective date and looks at the whole months from that date to the date of the release, and at the monthly payments issued on the award within those whole months.

| Monthly payments issued in the whole months since the effective date | Whole months since the effective date | Months owed |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | — | the number of those payments |
| none | one or more | those whole months |
| none | none | the effective month through the current month — 1 month |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Effective date 4 whole months ago; 3 monthly payments issued in those 4 months: 3 months owed.
- Effective date 2 whole months ago; no monthly payment issued in that time: 2 months owed.
- Effective date earlier in the current month, no whole month elapsed and no payment issued: 1 month owed.
